name: LanceDB v0.41.0
body:
This release uses Lance **14.0.2**.

## Python embedding configuration migration

This release changes `SentenceTransformerEmbeddings.trust_remote_code` to default to `False` and requires process-level approval before restoring remote-code models or custom endpoints from table metadata. Applications that reopen tables using these settings should explicitly approve the trusted model/revision or endpoint before computing embeddings:

```python
from lancedb.embeddings import get_registry

registry = get_registry()
registry.allow_remote_code("your-trusted-model", revision="your-reviewed-commit")
registry.allow_endpoint("https://your-trusted-endpoint.example")
```

Only approve models and endpoints that your application trusts. Unapproved restored configurations raise `UntrustedEmbeddingConfigError` when used; operations that do not compute embeddings remain available. See [the security fix and migration details](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4550).

Local SQL computed columns and materialized views remain experimental and require the `experimental-functions` build feature. The published Python and Node packages leave this feature disabled. Remote client operations remain available.
